title: Porsche’s new Taycan model year gets simulated gearshift – for an additional charge
content: Porsche has unveiled the 2027 Taycan, with the new optional 'E-Shift' mode among the most notable updates. As expected, the refreshed electric sports car gains a virtual gearbox, though customers must pay extra for the feature.
